summary: Confirmed DONE for the finding's scope, the standard boot graph. #710 (60633eff3) added a compile-time client-mode seam that resolves 7 hosted modules to inert *.standard siblings, and it also fixed the platform-barrel, authorization-barrel and vite define leaks. I re-ran the repo's own static-graph rules read-only with the seams applied. main.tsx, the boot-root lazy routes (ChatLayoutRouteView, ChatIndexRouteView), RootAppShell, ChatThreadRouteView, DraftChatThreadRouteView and PullRequestsPage have 0 forbidden hits. The current standard dist matches: the boot and boot-vendor chunks have no x25519/ed25519/chacha/cborg/HostedHubApi/hostedIdentity schemas, and chacha and cborg are in no chunk at all. Only small relay contract branded-id schemas (RelayNodeId, RelayE2eeDigest, ...) remain in boot, and desktop Hub connector/IPC contracts use them legitimately. The auditor missed one leak of the same kind outside boot. In standard and desktop builds, opening Settings statically loads hostedHub/api (HostedHubApi plus @noble curves, chunk api-*.js, 66 KB raw / 17.9 KB gzip). The cause is SettingsPanels -> DeviceIdentitySettings -> hostedHub/api, even though the only call is inside an isHostedHubMode() branch. Neither guard covers the Settings closure.

evidence.note: Seam list: hostedHub/state, bootGate, transport, hostedConnectionCoordinator, HostedConnectionControls, NoActiveThreadHostedStatus and pwa/lifecycle. The resolveId plugin is applied only for non-test standard builds.

The seam plugin is first in the plugin list, fed resolvedClientMode. The define at :152 now uses resolvedClientMode. The dev-proxy block at :178/:182/:188 still reads module-level clientMode (cosmetic, dev-only).

Source-level guard. I re-implemented its walk read-only with the vite-plus parseSync and the same forbidden rules. main.tsx, RootAppShell, PullRequestsPage, ChatLayout/ChatIndex/ChatThread/DraftChatThread route views have 0 hits. SettingsRouteView has 15 hits, but no test covers it.

The dist guard forbids HOSTED_RUNTIME_SOURCES in the boot (main), RootAppShell, ChatThreadRouteView and PullRequestsRouteView closures, and requires sourcemaps (bundleBudget.ts:61). CI runs it in .github/workflows/_validation.yml:209-213. There is no Settings closure.

Dist built at 21:45 after the HEAD commit at 21:40. The boot chunk statically imports only rolldown-runtime and boot-vendor. It has 0 hits for x25519/chacha20/hkdf/cborg/HostedHubApi/navigator.credentials/hostedIdentity schema ids. The only hosted leftovers are contracts/relay.ts branded ids such as RelayE2eeDigest, reached through the contracts barrel by hubConnector/ipc.
webPasskeyCeremony is gone from the platform barrel. passkeyCeremony.ts is imported only by hostedHub/api.ts and hostedHub/runtime.ts.

Now imports @ryco/client-runtime/relay/reconnectPolicy instead of the relay barrel. connectDesktopWorkspaceEnvironment (environments/runtime/service.ts:1317-1331) uses an IPC socket factory plus rpc/wsTransport, so the renderer needs no relay engine.

The only calls to the hosted-only transport stubs (getHostedRelayAttemptFactory and bindHostedDispatchReplay, which throw) sit behind isHostedHubMode(), so the seam cannot throw in standard or desktop builds.

Missed leak: a static `import { hostedHubApi } from "../../hostedHub/api"`. It is only used at :37-38 inside `isHostedHubMode() && hostedNode`. SettingsPanels.tsx:5 imports it statically, and SettingsPage and SettingsRouteView import that statically.

Has `import{t as Me}from"./api-BJhIvEex.js"` (used as Me.renameNode). api-BJhIvEex.js is the only chunk with x25519/ed25519 and HostedHubApi: 66,400 B raw, 17,860 B gzip. It loads on every Settings open in standard and desktop builds.

The Account section is hosted-only (settingsSections.logic.ts:75), so the AccountSettings import of hostedHub/api is lazy and never reached in standard builds. DeviceIdentitySettings is the only standard-reachable importer.

fixDefects: No defect in the boot-graph fix itself. There is a coverage gap outside the finding's boot scope: apps/web/src/components/settings/DeviceIdentitySettings.tsx:6 statically imports hostedHub/api, and SettingsPanels.tsx:5/547 renders that component eagerly. As a result every Settings open in standard and desktop builds downloads and parses api-*.js (HostedHubApi, the client-runtime authorization api, nativeE2eeEnrollment and @noble curves; 66 KB raw / ~18 KB gzip), although the only use (:37-38) is behind isHostedHubMode(). Neither guard catches it: standardBootGraph.test.ts has no Settings entry, and DEFAULT_BUNDLE_BUDGET_POLICY (scripts/perf/model.ts) has no SettingsRouteView closure. A cosmetic leftover is also still there: the vite.config.ts:178/182/188 dev proxy reads module-level clientMode instead of resolvedClientMode.
implementationSketch: 1) In apps/web/src/components/settings/DeviceIdentitySettings.tsx, drop the static hostedHub/api import. In the `isHostedHubMode() && hostedNode` branch, do `const { hostedHubApi } = await import("../../hostedHub/api");` before renameNode. Hosted builds already load api through state.ts, so they see no change. Alternative: add a renameNode method to the hosted controller, with a refusing stub in state.standard.ts (clientModeSeams.test.ts pins controller members). 2) Switch apps/web/src/components/settings/useDiagnosticsCapability.ts:1-4 from the @ryco/client-runtime/authorization barrel to @ryco/client-runtime/authorization/capabilities (hostedSessionAdmits and resolveHostedRpcCapability live in capabilities.ts), so the source walker does not see the barrel. 3) Add `it("keeps the hosted runtime out of Settings", () => expect(forbiddenChains("components/routeViews/SettingsRouteView.tsx", HOSTED_RUNTIME)).toEqual([]))` to apps/web/src/perf/standardBootGraph.test.ts. 4) Add `{ name: "SettingsRouteView", chunk: "SettingsRouteView", beyondBoot: true, maxGzipBytes: null, forbiddenSources: HOSTED_RUNTIME_SOURCES }` to DEFAULT_BUNDLE_BUDGET_POLICY in scripts/perf/model.ts. Verify with `bun run --cwd apps/web test src/perf/standardBootGraph.test.ts src/clientModeSeams.test.ts`, then a standard build with RYCO_WEB_SOURCEMAP=hidden and `bun run perf:bundle-budget`. Expect SettingsPanels-*.js to stop importing api-*.js. 5) Optionally replace clientMode with resolvedClientMode in the vite.config.ts dev-proxy block.
decisionReason: The leftover is only a lazy-load and guard change in a hosted-only branch. It changes no E2EE, auth or hosted lifecycle semantics, no Hub protocol and needs no deploy.
correction: The auditor said there were no fix defects that matter and called the api chunk 'reached lazily'. That is true for boot but understated for Settings. In standard and desktop builds, SettingsRouteView -> SettingsPage -> SettingsPanels -> DeviceIdentitySettings -> hostedHub/api is fully static, so the 66 KB / 18 KB gzip crypto and Hub API chunk loads on every Settings open, and no guard covers that closure. The DONE status for the boot-graph finding stands.
